rationale: All three blocking findings from the final round are resolved in commit 5d949ae: CR-001 (empty list 422 guard added with test), CR-002 (eligible alias set now built from pre-type-filter rows, type-excluded aliases no longer falsely reported as unknown, tests updated), CR-003 (NULL setting_type coalesced to USER in candidates comprehension, two tests confirm both inclusion and exclusion behavior).
